name: Cleon Euphemios
source:
Even though he is officially a 17-year-old high school student, he has a cheerful and naive attitude, making him seem like a junior high-schooler. His concentration ability is low, and he's easily distracted.

[Edited from [url=http://ahoguu.deviantart.com/journal/OrionxCleon-VN-Warm-Winter-427100836]DeviantArt[/url]]
